Insane Proprietor: Jeff only buys electronics from stores owned by them, because crazy store owners offer the best deals. Intoxication Ensues: Jeff accidentally eats one of Adam and Jennifer's pot brownies. There's not much difference between stoned Jeff and sober Jeff except stoned Jeff eats more. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Jeff tends to be cold and indifferent to just about everything Audrey talks about, but he loves her and always come through for her and his friends. He also does whatever he can to make a situation right once he realizes he's made a mistake.

In another episode we learn that Audrey once considered getting breast reduction surgery, but Jeff objected. Fake Pregnancy: In one episode Audrey isMistaken for Pregnantfollowing a poorly phrased remark at work. Finding she enjoys the attention, she then fakes being pregnant while she attempts to become pregnant for real. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Audrey is blonde and - snarkiness aside - probably the nicest of the main characters.

characters.name: Adam Rhodes
characters.description: Brainless Beauty: In one episode Adam scruffies himself up to try and prove that people like him for his personality, instead of just his looks. It doesn't work. Butt-Monkey: By the series end, Adam has somehow fallen so far down the social chain, even Russell and Timmy are a couple of notches above him. Camp Straight: Adam sometimes behaves in an effeminate or flamboyant manner, causing Russell and Jeff to crack jokes at his expense. It's even revealed in season 5 that Adam was a cheerleader when he was in high school. Caught with Your Pants Down: Jennifer refers to Adam as "Spanky" and he thinks this is because she walked in on him one time. He launches into a spirited defense of his actions in front of his friends, only to discover she was making a reference toThe Little Rascals. The Ditz: Especially in the later seasons. He is so naive and trusting that Jennifer can easily manipulate him into doing anything she wants (although she often feels guilty about it afterward).

characters.name: Jennifer Morgan
characters.description: Ambiguously Brown: At least according to Jeff. In one episode he mistakenly believes her to be a Latina (in reality, actress Bianca Kajlich is of Italian and Eastern European descent). Can't Take Criticism: Adam learns the hard way that working with Jennifer isn't all it's cracked up to be when he points out her graphic designs don't fit his company's identity. Clingy Jealous Girl: Jennifer gets this when Adam's ex-girlfriend comes to stay due to a hotel mix-up. Home Porn Movie: Adam and Jennifer make one of these in one episode, but it turns out that the camera does not flatter them and they're grossed out by how they look when they're having sex. In another episode, it's implied that one of Jennifer's old college boyfriends uploaded a tape of them having sex to the internet. Hypocrite: Jennifer finds Russell's womanizing repulsive, but she herself has an extensive history of sexual adventures.

characters.name: Russell Dunbar
characters.description: '70s Hair: Russell's moptop is noted to be severely dated and makes him look like like a porn tycoon. Bad Boss: To Timmy, although it gets less severe in the later seasons. Brilliant, but Lazy: Well, more like "Brilliant, But Horny"; in one episode we learn that when Russell doesn't spend all his time and energy trying to get laid he is a gifted violinist,sculptor,painter, and architect. Broke Episode: Russell's mom cuts off his trust fund, which only affects him in a couple of episodes in that he temporarily moves in with Timmy and has trouble getting women to sleep with him. But his financial problems only last for about two episodes. Bullying a Dragon: Russell routinely insults Jeff's intelligence and appearance, only to be quickly and utterly shut down every time. In an early episode, Jeff even noted that Russell should stop listening to whatever impulse is telling him not to be afraid of someone twice his size and much stronger than him.

characters.name: Timmy Patel
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Timmy is Russell's personal Butt-Monkey, though he doesn't get it as badly in later episodes. If anything, he actually manages to hand this trope squarely back to Russell by being aServile Snarker. Cassandra Truth: To his eternal frustration, Timmy's sister and parents find Russell charming regardless of Timmy's warnings. Characterization Marches On: Timmy was initially an enthusiastic and naive upstart hoping to earn Russell's good graces. By his second appearance he's already grown jaded and copes with his lot in life by making droll comments. Mistaken Nationality: Russell continually thinks Timmy is English. He is actually South African. Jeff is also confused that Timmy "talks one way but looks another". Noblewoman's Laugh: The few times that Timmy ever laughs reveal he's got averyeffete chortle.

characters.name: Doreen
characters.description: The surly waitress at the diner that the main characters frequent. Because You Were Nice to Me: In one episode Audrey was able to affect Jeff's diet by telling Doreen to deny Jeff any unhealthy orders. Doreen agrees, because unlike Jeff, Audrey tips. Big-Breast Pride: She's had her impressive bosom since she was 12 and isn't afraid to talk about it. Jaded Washout: Working in a dead-end job has left her understandably grumpy.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.description: Audrey's newly-divorced sister. All Girls Want Bad Boys: After years of being married to a man so safe he bored her, Barbara decides to casually date men she knows aren't husband material. Romantic False Lead: She's set up as a potential love interest for Russell, only to turn him down and enjoy the single life.

characters.name: Brad
characters.description: Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: He quielty fades from the main series after Season 3 despite being a close friend of Jeff's. Twofer Token Minority: Gay and African-American. Straight Gay: Jeff didn't clock that he was gay until he discovered Brad had a husband. Brad also dryly comments on his husband'sCamp Gaytendencies ("I'm not even that gay when we're having sex.").

characters.name: Liz
characters.description: Audrey's eccentric friend, who briefly married Russell. Abhorrrent Admirer: Jeff, Russell and Timmy all suffer her lustful side. Crazy Cat Lady: Liz owns a lot of cats and is completely oblivious to how socially awkward she is. Fan Disservice: "Want to know a secret about my breasts? One'slongerthan the other." Going Commando: Whil Liz is confirmed to wear panties (a pair fell out of her laundry basket one time), she's accustomed to wearing nothing underneath at the worst of times, such as when her bike shorts split or she played Twister.

characters.name: Brenda
characters.description: Jeff's baseball buddy, who later becomes a surrogate for the Bingham's baby. Girly Girl with a Tomboy Streak: Brenda is feminine enough to attract the attention of men, but she's essentially aDistaff Counterpartto Jeff. Lipstick Lesbian: Downplayed. Brenda enjoys baseball, beer and red meat, but she's conventionally feminine in appearance. Longest Pregnancy Ever: Brenda becomes a surrogate in the second half of Season 5, but doesn't give birth until the finale, 2 seasons later.

characters.name: Allison
characters.description: An employee of Russell's and Timmy's temporary girlfriend. Cold Turkeys Are Everywhere: Allison thinks she and Timmy are being too physical and decide to put off sex to form an emotional bond. Then they're cramped into an elevator with their fronts pressed up against each other. The Cutie: She's very innocent and wholesome, though not without her horny side as Timmy eventually discovers. Put on a Bus: She moves out of New York and her relationship with Timmy fades away soon after.
